metaDescription: What {brand} sells, what it doesn't, and how payment, delivery by {method}, refunds and the item guarantee work.

hero.title: A store for Counter-Strike 2 skins
hero.lead: {brand} sells weapon skins, knives and gloves for {game} to customers in the {countries}. We are a store, not a marketplace: you buy items from us, and each one is delivered to your Steam account by trade offer.

range.title: What we sell
range.body: Cosmetic items for weapons, knives and gloves, sorted by weapon type and then by weapon:

listing.title: What every listing shows
listing.single: One item in one condition. Each listing can be bought once.
listing.exterior: Rarity, exterior and quality, with the float range that exterior allows for the finish.
listing.image: The standard Steam image of the item.
listing.prices: A price you can view in {currencies}, confirmed again before you pay.

items.marketplace: Buy, list or exchange items from users. {brand} does not take items in.
items.cases: Sell cases, keys, stickers or agents.
items.accounts: Sell Steam accounts, or ask for your Steam password or Steam Guard codes.
items.other: Offer gambling, case openings or anything with a random outcome.

order.label: Payment
order.body: Pay by card ({cardMethods}) on our payment provider's secure page. Prices can be shown in {currencies}.

delivery.label: Delivery
delivery.body: Each item arrives as a {method}, {usual}. Steam may keep received items under trade protection for up to {days} days.

guarantee.label: Item guarantee
guarantee.body: If we cannot deliver an item within {hours} hours, or Steam reverses the trade, we refund it within {refundDays} days.

withdrawal.label: Withdrawal
withdrawal.body: You can cancel for free until delivery begins. The {days}-day right of withdrawal ends once delivery has begun at your request.
